subject: general
question: Where has the narrator of story gone visit a dentist?
solution:
The correct answer is "**London.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The question asks about the place where the narrator of story was gone.
 
• Refer to the following lines from the passage:
 
 
• Line 1: **The narrator of this story is a 12-year-old girl who has gone to London** with her mother to visit the dentist.
 
 
 
• From the above mentioned line, it is clear that the narrator of the story went to London.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.
